note: Object library for size ladders (owner 21.11). Every object: a real, recognisable thing; its height from two sources; a 3D model that is CC0 / public domain (NASA, Poly Haven, Smithsonian CC0, MakeHuman CC0), CC BY with attribution, or modelled here from official dimensions. A new object gets a trial frame first (object-trial.yml); 'approved' objects are reused, 'rejected' ones (toy-like, wrong) are never used. Public-domain statues only; buildings without logos or advertising.

pyramid.name: GREAT PYRAMID
sources: Wikipedia Great Pyramid of Giza: 138.5 m

astronaut.name: ASTRONAUT
sources: NASA Project Mercury selection: astronauts no taller than 5 ft 11 in (1.80 m)

shuttle.name: SPACE SHUTTLE

shuttle.trial: first trial: lying on its side (seen from the engines); retried upright

hyperion.name: HYPERION (REDWOOD)
sources: US National Park Service (Redwood NP): Hyperion 380 ft (116 m)
hyperion.credit: 3D model: Poly Haven (CC0), stand-in conifer scaled to the measured height
hyperion.why: the stand-in fir looks like a thin sapling, not a giant redwood (toy-like at 116 m); the file also holds several trees
